title: Carne Asada {p} with {v}
steps: Marinate the {p} in oil, a squeeze of lime, a splash of soy sauce, garlic and the {spice} for at least 30 minutes.
Start the sides during the marinade. {starch_how} {veg_how}

Cook the {p} over very high heat, 2 to 3 minutes per side, until charred. Check the thickest part with a thermometer. The USDA safe minimum for steak is 145°F / 63°C. A lower doneness is your choice and carries more risk.
Rest the {p} 5 minutes, then slice thinly against the grain.
Serve with the {v} and {s}, and the {sauce} on top.
tip: Fill the tortillas with plenty of peppers and onions, and use a little less steak.
